notes: Graphiti does NOT deduplicate episodes by name or content: re-adding creates a second Episodic node (entities and the identical-fact edge are deduplicated, but the edge's .episodes list grows). Re-adding with the SAME explicit uuid is idempotent (one Episodic node) - BUT add_episode(uuid=...) only CONTINUES an episode that already exists (NodeNotFoundError otherwise), so the worker must first save an EpisodicNode with the deterministic uuid (graphiti.nodes.episode.save) and then call add_episode(uuid=...). Decision (confirms ING-01): idempotency lives in the platform ledger keyed (workspace, source_key, stage); the worker derives uuid5(namespace, ledger key) so a retry reuses the same episode, and records the Graphiti episode uuid in the ledger before marking the stage done. A repeat add still costs LLM calls (see chat_calls_second), so the ledger must prevent needless replays rather than rely on Graphiti.
